benchmark_metadata.title: LeakGuard Python Test Corpus Benchmark
benchmark_metadata.scope: Intra-procedural AST Resource Lifecycle & Conservative Ownership Analysis

metrics_definitions.true_positives: Expected LEAK correctly identified as LEAK
metrics_definitions.false_positives: Expected SAFE incorrectly identified as LEAK
metrics_definitions.false_negatives: Expected LEAK incorrectly marked as SAFE
metrics_definitions.true_negatives: Expected SAFE correctly verified as SAFE
metrics_definitions.unknown_positives: Expected UNKNOWN correctly identified as ambiguous ownership
metrics_definitions.unknown_rate: Fraction of all corpus cases exhibiting ambiguous ownership (UNKNOWN / Total)
metrics_definitions.precision: TP / (TP + FP) — fraction of reported leaks that are genuine leaks
metrics_definitions.recall: TP / (TP + FN) — fraction of all actual leaks that were detected
metrics_definitions.f1_score: Harmonic mean of precision and recall

disclaimer: This benchmark is self-created for the LeakGuard hackathon corpus. Metrics reflect actual performance on the 46 included canonical test files. Conservative ownership tracking identifies escaped resources as UNKNOWN rather than assuming SAFE or LEAK. Metrics are measured on this curated corpus and do not represent universal real-world accuracy.

cases.description: Sequential file open and return without close()
cases.details: L4: open() -> L6: return (leak)
cases.recommendation: Call 'f.close()' before returning at line 6, or use 'with open(...) as f:'.

cases.description: File open with early return in if branch before close()
cases.details: L4: open() -> L5: if skip -> L6: return (leak)
cases.recommendation: Use 'with open(...) as f:', or invoke 'f.close()' before returning at line 6.

cases.description: File open with unclosed return inside except handler
cases.details: L5: open() -> L6: try -> L8: except Exception -> L9: return (leak)
cases.recommendation: Ensure 'f.close()' is called in a 'finally:' block or inside the 'except Exception' handler, or use 'with open(...) as f:'.

cases.description: File open with unhandled raise before close()
cases.details: L5: open() -> L6: raise (leak)
cases.recommendation: Wrap resource in 'try...finally' to guarantee 'f.close()' runs on error.

cases.description: sqlite3.connect() allocated without close()
cases.details: L5: sqlite3.connect() -> L8: return (leak)
cases.recommendation: Call 'conn.close()' before returning at line 8, or wrap in try...finally.

cases.description: sqlite3.connect() with early return in if branch
cases.details: L5: sqlite3.connect() -> L6: if flag -> L7: return (leak)
cases.recommendation: Invoke 'conn.close()' before returning at line 7, or wrap in try...finally.

cases.description: Handle overwritten before previous resource was closed
cases.details: L4: open() -> L5: reassigned
cases.recommendation: Close previous resource 'f.close()' before reassigning.

cases.description: Resource aliased to secondary variable but neither closed
cases.details: L4: open() -> L6: return (leak)
cases.recommendation: Call 'f.close()' before returning at line 6, or use 'with open(...) as f:'.

cases.description: Early return inside nested conditional branch
cases.details: L5: open() -> L6: if env == 'production' -> L8: return (leak)
cases.recommendation: Use 'with open(...) as f:', or invoke 'f.close()' before returning at line 8.

cases.description: Early exit in nested try-except bypasses cleanup
cases.details: L5: open() -> L6: try -> L12: return (leak)
cases.recommendation: Ensure 'f.close()' executes in a 'finally:' block, or use 'with open(...) as f:'.

cases.description: Multiple resources allocated, but one is never closed
cases.details: L6: open() -> L11: return (leak)
cases.recommendation: Call 'dst.close()' before returning at line 11, or use 'with open(...) as dst:'.

cases.description: Multiple database connections with one leaked
cases.details: L8: sqlite3.connect() -> L12: return (leak)
cases.recommendation: Call 'db2.close()' before returning at line 12, or wrap in try...finally.

cases.description: Resource closed in one branch but unclosed in the other
cases.details: L5: open() -> L6: else -> L11: return (leak)
cases.recommendation: Use 'with open(...) as f:', or invoke 'f.close()' before returning at line 11.

cases.description: Early exit from loop skips subsequent cleanup
cases.details: L5: open() -> L6: loop -> L8: return (leak)
cases.recommendation: Call 'f.close()' before returning at line 8, or use 'with open(...) as f:'.

cases.description: Adversarial: Error handler catches exception and returns before close
cases.details: L5: open() -> L6: try -> L9: except ValueError -> L10: return (leak)
cases.recommendation: Ensure 'f.close()' is called in a 'finally:' block or inside the 'except ValueError' handler, or use 'with open(...) as f:'.

cases.description: Adversarial: Active resource overwritten with None
cases.details: L5: open() -> L7: reassigned
cases.recommendation: Close previous resource 'f.close()' before reassigning.

cases.description: Resource passed to external/unprovable function
cases.details: L8: open() -> L9: external_consumer(f) (ownership transferred)
cases.recommendation: Ensure 'external_consumer()' or caller closes the resource, or manage lifecycle locally.

cases.description: Resource handle returned to caller
cases.details: L4: open() -> L5: return f (ownership transferred via return)
cases.recommendation: Ensure caller of 'create_stream' manages and closes the returned resource.

cases.description: Resource stored in object attribute
cases.details: L5: open() -> attribute storage 'self.handle'
cases.recommendation: Ensure 'self.handle' is closed in a cleanup method or context manager.

cases.description: Resource appended into collection container
cases.details: L5: open() -> L6: container escape
cases.recommendation: Ensure resources stored in container are closed when no longer needed.

cases.description: Helper in same module closes resource conditionally
cases.details: L10: open() -> L12: maybe_close(f) (ownership transferred)
cases.recommendation: Ensure 'maybe_close()' or caller closes the resource, or manage lifecycle locally.

cases.description: Resource passed to external library function
cases.details: L7: open() -> L9: copyfileobj(f) (ownership transferred)
cases.recommendation: Ensure 'copyfileobj()' or caller closes the resource, or manage lifecycle locally.

cases.description: Resource transferred via keyword argument
cases.details: L9: open() -> L11: dispatch_job(f) (ownership transferred)
cases.recommendation: Ensure 'dispatch_job()' or caller closes the resource, or manage lifecycle locally.

cases.description: Resource stored into dictionary mapping by subscript
cases.details: L5: open() -> L7: container escape
cases.recommendation: Ensure resources stored in container are closed when no longer needed.

cases.description: SQLite connection passed to external migration handler
cases.details: L11: sqlite3.connect() -> L13: run_migration_externally(conn) (ownership transferred)
cases.recommendation: Ensure 'run_migration_externally()' or caller closes the resource, or manage lifecycle locally.

cases.description: Resource added to container using extend()
cases.details: L5: open() -> L7: container escape
cases.recommendation: Ensure resources stored in container are closed when no longer needed.
